art_note: Clean studio product shots, but model imagery relies on obvious digital compositing.
desc_en: A clean-lined silhouette designed to project inner confidence and commanding presence. This long-sleeve bodysuit features a sophisticated square neckline and the house graphic front detail. Crafted from a soft touch, subtly elastic fabric that flows effortlessly along the body contours. Each piece is made to order with worldwide shipping available.
desc_es: Una prenda de líneas limpias diseñada para proyectar seguridad interior y presencia impecable. Este body de manga larga presenta un sofisticado cuello cuadrado y el distintivo gráfico frontal de la casa. Confeccionado en un tejido suave y de tacto fluido que se adapta con precisión al contorno corporal. Cada pieza se elabora bajo pedido en nuestros talleres con disponibilidad de envío internacional.
details_en:
· Composition: 86% polyester, 14% elastane
· Design: Long sleeve, square neckline, slim fit, and front graphic print
· Fit: Form-fitting cut with a three-snap button closure at the crotch
· Made-to-order piece
· Worldwide shipping available
